Incidents.Description: Thru this afternoon, Yellow Line trains will continue to operate between Huntington and Mt. Vernon Square/Fort Totten only as a result of a track problem outside College Park. Customers can continue their trip to Greenbelt by boarding a Green Line train. Due to single tracking on the Green Line between Hyattsville Crossing and College Park, customers may encounter delays up to 12 minutes.

Thru this afternoon, Green Line trains will continue to operate every 12 minutes with single tracking between Hyattsville Crossing and College Park due to a track problem outside College Park. Customers should plan for additional travel time. We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this issue.
This weekend, trains are operating every 12-30 minutes w/ single tracking between Vienna and West Falls Church due to planned work.
Customers traveling inbound toward Washington, D.C., or outbound toward Vienna, must transfer trains at West Falls Church.

Thru Sept 6th, shuttle buses replace trains between North Bethesda and Friendship Heights due to summer construction. As a result, Grosvenor, Medical Center, and Bethesda stations are closed. Express shuttle bus service is available between North Bethesda and Friendship Heights.
